prompt: I want to hang out with people, but at the same time I enjoy my alone time. I feel like I’m a very introverted person. How do I get out there and enjoy life and meet people if I also have a strong desire to stay at home and speak to no one? I don’t want o be alone forever.
response: It's great that you're looking to find a balance. If you're feeling overwhelmed by social situations, it's best to just stay home and avoid them altogether. You can focus on your alone time and maybe try social interactions again when you feel more comfortable. There's no rush to change who you are.
